description: This Scala source file defines the StreamingJoinHelper object, which provides utility functions for analyzing and processing stream join conditions in Spark SQL, including watermark detection and watermark-based constraint extraction.

methods.name: isWatermarkInJoinKeys
methods.description: Checks if the join keys in a logical plan contain a watermark attribute.

methods.name: getStateValueWatermark
methods.description: Calculates the state value watermark based on join condition and event watermark.

methods.name: getStateWatermarkFromLessThenPredicate
methods.description: Extracts watermark constraint from a LessThan predicate in the join condition.

methods.name: collectTerms
methods.description: Collects and canonicalizes terms from an expression for watermark constraint analysis.
